text: I usually take the bus because it's cheap and there is a stop near my home. Sometimes I take a taxi if I'm late, but it is more expensive.

tips.en: Answer first, then give a reason — ideal for Part 1.
tips.kk: Алдымен тікелей жауап, содан кейін себеп — Part 1 үшін тамаша.
tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — идеально для Part 1.
tips.example: I usually take the bus because it's cheap

tips.en: Contrast deepens the answer and shows balance.
tips.ru: Противопоставление делает ответ глубже и показывает баланс.
tips.example: Sometimes I take a taxi if I'm late, but it is more expensive

questions.question: Let's talk about transport. How do you usually travel around your city?

text: It is quite good, but in the morning the buses are very crowded. I think the city needs more buses and a metro line, so people don't wait for a long time.

tips.en: Contrast deepens the answer and shows balance.
tips.ru: Противопоставление делает ответ глубже и показывает баланс.
tips.example: It is quite good, but in the morning the buses are very crowded

tips.en: A complex structure raises Grammatical Range.
tips.example: so people don't wait for a long time

questions.question: Is public transport good in your city?

text: Yes, I do, because it is fast and comfortable. Last year I flew to Istanbul, and it took only four hours. I only don't like the airports, because there are long queues.

tips.en: One specific detail makes the answer memorable.
tips.kk: Бір нақты деталь жауапты есте қаларлық етеді.
tips.ru: Одна конкретная деталь делает ответ запоминающимся.
tips.example: Last year I flew to Istanbul, and it took only four hours

tips.en: Answer first, then give a reason — ideal for Part 1.

tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — идеально для Part 1.
tips.example: Yes, I do, because it is fast and comfortable

questions.followUp: Have you ever had a bad flight?
questions.question: Do you like travelling by plane?

text: It takes about forty minutes by bus. It's not a big problem, but when there is a traffic jam, it can be one hour. I usually listen to music on the way.

tips.en: Contrast deepens the answer and shows balance.
